_comment: Static per-unit specs, section 2 of the build spec. These describe the platform, not any single mission; the scripted mission lives in sim/mission_timeline.json.

rover.wheel_layout: six wheel rocker bogie, four station steering
rover.steering_note: two rear wheels steer individually, two front bogies steer as a rigid unit
rover.compute_note: Orin NX + STM32H7 pair, from the L0.3 power budget
rover.radio: AES-256 frequency hopping, Silvus StreamCaster in production or Doodle Labs Helix for the prototype

tricopters.configuration_note: two tilting lift rotors plus one tail pusher, three rotors total. This document uses compound bicopter throughout, matching the engineering baseline and patent language; external decks use nano tricopter, section 14
tricopters.video_link: 5.8 GHz, acknowledged weak point against a jamming threat
